description: Deterministic fallback recipe for the create-ui-spec tool. Pinning field-by-field assembly rules, unavailable model-dependent decisions, allowed warning codes, allowed evidence kinds, and the single offline acceptance criterion. The producer (Task 3) imports this recipe directly via a NodeNext JSON import attribute and emits decisions purely from it — no model is consulted and no corpus claim is invented.

designDirection.note: Re-statement of the requester's productContext as the canonical design direction; no invented direction.

rejectedDefaults.note: The deterministic fallback rejects no defaults by invention; an empty array is the truthful zero-evidence state.

layoutRegions.note: No layout regions are synthesized without corpus evidence.

responsiveBehavior.note: No responsive behavior statements are invented.

componentInventory.note: No components are invented without corpus evidence.

accessibilityConstraints.note: Accessibility statements are not invented; the producer surfaces a single manual acceptance criterion instead.

contentVoiceGuidance.note: Voice guidance is omitted unless explicitly supplied by the requester; no editorial voice is invented.

techniques.note: No stealable techniques are invented without corpus evidence.

antiPatterns.note: No anti-patterns are invented without corpus evidence.

frameworkNotes.note: Framework notes are omitted unless the requester supplies an implementationFramework.

colorTokens.note: Color tokens are model-dependent; no implicit color is invented. The producer emits null tokens with editorial authority and lists the decision in unavailableDecisions.

typographyTokens.note: Typography tokens are model-dependent; no implicit typography is invented. The producer emits null tokens with editorial authority and lists the decision in unavailableDecisions.

motionGuidance.note: Motion guidance is model-dependent; the producer truthfully marks evidenceUnavailable=true and lists the decision in unavailableDecisions.

citedDecisions.note: No cited decisions are invented; the fallback cites no corpus- or reference-derived authority.

citedReferences.note: No references are cited unless the requester supplied explicit public references.

unavailableDecisions.reason: Color tokens are model-dependent and cannot be produced deterministically; no implicit color is invented.
Typography tokens are model-dependent and cannot be produced deterministically; no implicit typography is invented.
Motion guidance is model-dependent; no motion direction is invented and evidence is marked unavailable.

acceptanceCriteria.subject: produced create-ui-spec
acceptanceCriteria.expectedOutcome: A human operator confirms the produced spec is internally consistent and does not claim corpus or model-derived evidence that was not supplied.
manualSteps: Open the produced create-ui-spec and confirm every decision field is either empty/omitted, null with editorial authority, or echoes supplied requester input.
Confirm colorTokens and typographyTokens are null with editorial authority and no specific color or font values are asserted.
Confirm motionGuidance.evidenceUnavailable is true and no motion direction is asserted.
Confirm no corpus ids, source urls, screenshot paths, or product identities appear in the spec.
